items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: Took Johnson and them come aboard, and I got Took to fix the dance, you know. We played dance.

ctx.x: We didn't have nothing to do, we had to make a parade in Baton Rouge and bring them fellas down to the hotel. And we was through, you see. Took Johnson and them come aboard, and I got Took to fix the dance, you know. We played dance. Made nice money on that. And from Baton Rouge we come to New Orleans, you see, and back. Back to Monroe, the paid us off in Monroe. And man, you know, they didn't have no liquor in Sreeport. All of us got us one of them big, there-go baskets and bought beer and different stuff, you…
